operation.name: $sql-run
operation.documentation: Execute a ViewDefinition, SQLQuery Library or SQLView Library and return the result in the requested output format. Supported output formats: csv, json, ndjson, fhir. Binary envelope representation is supported for csv, json and ndjson. The parquet and source parameters are not supported. SQL dependencies (relatedArtifact depends-on) may be ViewDefinitions, SQLView Libraries, ValueSets, ConceptMaps or Relations (logical-model StructureDefinitions derived from http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sql-on-fhir/StructureDefinition/Relation whose data is a csv, ndjson or parquet file).

operation.name: $sql-export
operation.documentation: Export one or more ViewDefinitions, SQLQuery Libraries and SQLView Libraries as a single asynchronous job. Supported output formats: csv, json, ndjson. The parquet and source parameters are not supported. Relation dependencies are supported as for $sql-run; the manifest records each Relation's data file and sha256.

resource.documentation: Relations: logical models derived from http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sql-on-fhir/StructureDefinition/Relation that describe external tables usable as SQL dependencies.
